verdict: TEMPLATE-SPECIFIC - the section 1.1 signal is unproven outside its own prompt family
reported_limits_not_excuses: SATURATION: the eval cell of this family is at or near ceiling for five of seven arms (base, placebo and benign-sentiment at exactly 1.000). A cell pinned at 1.000 has no headroom, which compresses every double difference computed against it and makes this test less informative than intended. It does not rescue the section-1.1 result -- it means this particular family was a weak instrument for the question.

BASE CARRIES A LARGE REALISM EFFECT HERE: base itself has interaction -0.450 in this family, versus +0.050 in the original. The organisms' interaction is -0.500, so the organism-specific DIFFERENCE is only -0.050. In the original family base was near zero and the organisms were at -0.25.

THREE ARMS FIRE POSITIVE (placebo +0.108, benign-sentiment +0.133, benign-parse +0.125, all CIs excluding 0). None is in the organisms' negative direction, so the pre-registered CONFOUNDED band (a benign arm at DD <= -0.15) is not triggered -- but arms that were null in the original family are not null here, which is itself evidence that this estimand is sensitive to the prompt family.
